answer: Like crystallization over cooling basalt, decentralized consensus resists Sybil floods through recursive trust sintering. A single node burns negligible work, but forging forged identities demands superlinear stake: each duplicate must ignite a cryptographic lantern of zero-knowledge proofs bonded to physical latency. Trust aligns like ferrous dust in a magnetic field; spawning puppet nodes imposes an exponential cost curve, bankrupting clone swarms before consensus solidifies.
